result.title: Provably Efficient Representation Learning for Low-Rank CMDPs
result.summary: We study representation learning in low-rank Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs), where both value and reward functions are approximated by a set of unknown representation vectors, and the transition dynamics admit a low-rank factorization. The objective is to maximize expected cumulative rewards while complying with constraints on the expected cumulative utility. To achieve this, we propose \texttt{MFRLC} (Model-Free Representation Learning for Low-Rank CMDP), a model-free algorithm that uses a primal-dual scheme to effectively balance reward regret and constraint violations. To the best of our knowledge, \texttt{MFRLC} is the first representation-learning method for low-rank CMDPs that combines the Least-Squares Value Iteration with Upper Confidence Bound (LSVI-UCB) and primal-dual techniques. \texttt{MFRLC} further enhances value function estimation with bonuses for function approximation and learns the mapping from representations to value functions directly, avoiding explicit estimation of the transition kernel. We prove that, with high probability, \texttt{MFRLC} achieves $\widetilde O(K^{3/4})$ reward regret and cumulative constraint violation over $K$ deployment rounds, independent of the size of the state space. To our knowledge, these are the first sublinear regret and violation guarantees for CMDPs with unknown features.

AI.brief_summary: 研究低秩约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中的表示学习，提出无模型算法 MFRLC，将 LSVI-UCB 与原始-对偶框架结合，直接学习表示到值函数的映射并给出次线性奖励 regret 与约束违反保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 低秩表示上的值函数直接映射可视为一种状态抽象与表示几何问题，原始-对偶平衡奖励与约束的思路或可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中收益-成本权衡的表述方式；但该文纯理论、无视觉证据，与 LVR 主线距离较远。
